subject: English
stimulus: (a) Uneasy lies the head ⎯⎯. (b) Take an umbrella lest ⎯⎯. (c) The mothers who are educated ⎯⎯. (d) He walked as though ⎯⎯. (e) Make hay while ⎯⎯.
guide_solution: Completing sentences (a) Uneasy lies the head that wears a crown. (b) Take an umbrella lest you should/might get wet. (c) The mothers who are educated help a nation to prosper. (d) He walked as though he had been drunkard. (e) Make hay while the sun shines.
